## 1. Abstract & Formal Statement

With link phases U_ij = exp(i A_ij) and oriented plaquette products U_p, the Wilson action S = beta_g sum_p (1 - Re U_p) is invariant under local U(1) gauge transformations and nonnegative.

### Governing Obligation
Standard lattice-gauge fact imported, not established in this checkout; the source supplies no fermion-sign consequence for it.

### Witness Audit
Cited NonAbelianGaugeSigns.lean::u1_plaquette_gauge_invariance does not exist. regge_wdw_core.lean::simplicial_u1_gauge_transformation_invariant states integer telescoping of gauge shifts around one triangle, but regge_wdw_core.lean is not a lakefile root and is not imported, so lake build never elaborates it.
